tips.text: Buy it the first visit it shows up; it can go many months before Baro stocks it again.
Keep enough Ducats banked so a surprise visit never catches you short.
Crack relics in a full squad of four so you can take the highest-Ducat reward of four.
Sell duplicate Prime parts first; a spare pile often covers the whole Ducat cost.
Do not buy the Prisma Machete for this target; only the Machete Wraith counts.
Ignore the Machete Wraith Duviri loadouts hand out; it never joins your arsenal or gives Mastery.
Treat it as Mastery fodder; the Ducats are trivial and waiting for Baro is the only cost.
